t: You're on Whitfield Street, a Camden street running north from Goodge Street's neighbourhood up to Warren Street. It's crossed by Grafton Way, Maple Street, Howland Street, Tottenham Street and Goodge Street, with Hertford Place, Chitty Street and Scala Street joining on the western side. The name comes from George Whitefield, the eighteenth-century English Anglican priest and travelling preacher. He was one of the founders of Methodism and of the evangelical movement, so the street carries the name of a man who helped shape English religious life.
